vocabulary.meaning: a meal eaten together by members of a family
examples: Family meal is an important idea when discussing stress-free family meals.
Learning about family meal can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: the usual time at which a meal is eaten
examples: People often have different views about mealtime when discussing stress-free family meals.
Understanding mealtime can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a regular pattern of activities or behaviour
examples: The topic of stress-free family meals raises useful questions about routine.
We can discuss how routine affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a person, especially a child, who is unwilling to eat many types of food
examples: Picky eater can play an important role in debates about stress-free family meals.
Different countries may deal with picky eater in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: socially accepted ways of behaving while eating
examples: A discussion about stress-free family meals can include the effects of table manners.
Knowing the meaning of table manners makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the development of close emotional relationships among family members
examples: Family bonding is useful vocabulary for talking about stress-free family meals.
We can use the idea of family bonding to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
